notes: Access: direct fetch worked throughout (HTTP 200 on every page, no WAF/bot-block encountered; robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow, only generic Disallow on /cart, /profile, /auth, /wishlist and the internal category_l1/l2/l3+brand sitemap XML feeds - none of that blocked our normal browsing). Urban Ladder is majority-owned by Reliance Retail since 2020 and its storefront now runs on Reliance's 'Swadesh Online' multi-brand commerce platform (cdn/api host swadeshonline.com visible in page source); the catalog therefore mixes Urban Ladder's own SKUs with several third-party home-decor sellers (Tayhaa, Vedas, Elare, Desert Art, Orange Tree, Aapno Rajasthan, etc.), which explains larger-than-expected decor/lighting counts for a furniture-led brand. Verification method: each collection page shows a JS-rendered 'N Products' badge; RULE 1 exhaustion-check was done by cross-summing the page's own Primary-Material facet counts (an independent backend aggregation) against that badge - Study Lamps 31=26+3+2, Table Lamps 2238=1043+440+418+237+53+44+2+1, Floor Lamps 1234=652+510+43+21+6+1+1, Ceiling Lights 591=196+138+133+113+7+4, Wall Lights 1647=1155+323+113+51+4+1, Outdoor Lights 34=33+1, Mirrors 122=61+37+21+1+1+1, Clocks/Wall Clocks 199=137+44+18, Photo Frames 5=4+1, Vases 19=15+2+1+1, Showpieces 512=167+159+87+86+10+3, Lamps parent 3503 = sum of its 3 children exactly - all matched exactly except Wall Art (badge 1768 vs facet-sum 1770, 0.1% variance, accepted). Parent 'Lighting' (5941) and parent 'Home Decor' (754) and parent 'Wall Decor' (1716) do not equal the sum of their found children (extra untagged SKUs with no dedicated sub-collection URL, e.g. pendant/chandelier lighting or misc decor items) - per the mixed-rollup 'drop, don't pad' rule these parent umbrella totals are NOT used as qty on any row; only their concrete, individually verified child collections are reported. Exclusions applied: 'Bathroom Accessories' (16) inspected by title -> 100% bath/kitchen towels (textile), fully excluded, not listed. 'Artificial Plants', 'Bedsheets', 'Cushion Covers', 'Comforters', 'Carpets', 'Bath Mats' present in nav but are textile/faux-plant, excluded per scope. Rule 0 gain: 'Outdoor Lights' (34, titled as Festive Lights in one nav label) verified by title-scan to be genuine fixtures (wall lights, garden spotlights, bollard/gate lights) not bulbs/wiring, so kept in scope despite the 'outdoor'/room-style name. Showpieces (512) is a single product-type collection, not a category roll-up, but title-sampling of its 'candle' subset (sitewide search q=candle=26, q=scented=3) shows it is intermixed with a small number of scented poured candles (Home Fragrance, out of scope) alongside genuine candle holders/stands (in scope); estimated contamination is roughly 2-3% of the 512 and the site provides no facet to cleanly exclude just the scented items, so the verified badge total is kept with a caution flag on that row rather than being nulled, since the category is overwhelmingly in-scope decorative showpieces/figurines. Photo Frames (5) included as a borderline decorative-wall-accessory judgment call (not explicitly listed in scope bullets but not excluded either; site files it under Wall Decor next to Wall Art/Mirrors/Clocks). Duplicate-company check: no other entry in this project matches Urban Ladder (urbanladder.com); distinct India-based furniture-led omnichannel retailer, not a re-list of any other company.
